conclusions: Original logic animation durations come from UnitPuppet/AnimDuration tables, independently of missing render art binaries.
Scale3Chain graphical model is a separate plain object; its animation termination is not by itself an engine entity termination.
Every original callback must still execute; timers, fields, aliases and source actor-method writes must be preserved.

TechMouse.realKnockSelfFlag is written by an actor update but its source reads are confined to that actor update; the skill reset clears it. Preserving the original method needs device scale state, not texture pixels.
No conclusion about every actor getter, callback, animation event, action completion or transitive helper is implied by this inventory. Unknown paths must remain fail closed.
